10291a44c7.q: What are the judging criteria and medal categories used in the Daily Pourer Zero Proof Choice Awards?
10291a44c7.a: Products are tasted blind by judges in triads. Each judge receives just a glass with liquid and assigns it a medal: bronze, silver, or gold. When all judges at the table agree it is excellent, the product receives double gold, meaning everyone rated it gold from the beginning.
